# Meeting Briefing: Perplexity AI
**Date/Time:** November 20, 2026 @ 10:00 AM (+05:30)  

---

## ## Recent developments
* **Open-Weight Model Releases:** On November 13, 2026, Perplexity released open weights for `pplx-decider-v1.3` and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.3` under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face. These models focus on text-span extraction and routing classification [1].
* **Teammates Expansion:** In mid-November 2026, Perplexity expanded its proactive agentic feature called "Teammates"—previously limited to iOS and the web—to the macOS app for Max subscribers [4].
* **Business and Enterprise Growth:** Reports in November 2026 highlighted that Perplexity's annual run-rate surpassed US$750 million, driven by enterprise adoption (such as PayPal running thousands of queries weekly) and integration within platforms like Samsung's Galaxy S26 Galaxy AI [2].
* **Legal Challenges:** A class-action lawsuit was filed against Perplexity AI in a California federal court in November 2026, alleging misleading practices regarding undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription tiers [3].

## ## Talking points
* Discuss the strategic goals of the newly released `pplx-decider-v1.3` and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.3` open-weight models for enterprise research workflows [1].
* Explore the adoption metrics and feedback for "Teammates" following its recent rollout to macOS and mobile platforms [4].
* Review scaling strategies as the answer engine's annualized run-rate reaches US$750 million and enterprise integrations expand [2].

## ## Open questions
* How do the newly introduced open-weight decider models integrate into Perplexity’s existing orchestration layer for enterprise customers?
* What are Perplexity's plans for addressing the recent class-action litigation regarding subscription usage caps [3]?
* How does the expansion of system-level integrations (such as with Samsung's Galaxy AI) impact user acquisition and server-side infrastructure costs?

## ## Sources
* [1] [CASRAI - Perplexity Releases Open-Weight Decider v1.3 and Flash Decision Models](https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026)
* [2] [AI Magazine - Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate](https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate)
* [3] [Top Class Actions - Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features)
* [4] [9to5Mac - Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brings-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac)
